day5_morning_plan_escape.text: *Last night, the plan was escape. First, getting out alive. Evidence could wait.*

day5_morning_plan_expose.text: *Last night, the plan was exposure. Getting out alive and leaving a record—I decided not to miss either.*

day5_morning_plan_confront.text: *Last night, the plan was confrontation. I wouldn't run; I'd see it to the end, I wrote with trembling hands.*

day5_morning_dawn_1.text: *4 AM. I couldn't sleep. No — I wasn't allowed to sleep.*

day5_morning_dawn_2.text: *I check the clock in the darkness. The fluorescent hands tremble. — No, it's my hands that are trembling.*

day5_morning_dawn_3.text:
*I check my bag. The handwritten notes, my phone, the evidence I secured. Battery at 68%. A Student Safety app notification floats over the lock screen.*

*`Attendance scheduled 08:10`*

*The notification blinks once.*

*`Collection scheduled 23:00`*

*I turn the screen off with my thumb.*

day5_morning_dawn_4.text:
*I take out my notebook. The operation I wrote down last night. My handwriting shakes so badly half of it is hard to read. At the very bottom, there is one sentence that does not look like something I wrote.*

*`Second staircase. Do not run.`*

*The pen marks are deep enough to tear the paper.*

day5_morning_dawn_5.text: *I tied my sneakers tight. I might have to run.*

day5_morning_dawn_6.text: *I stood at the door. Paused for a moment.*

day5_morning_dawn_7.text: *Beyond the door. The hallway. The silence of 4 AM has pooled in the crack beneath the door. No hum of fluorescent lights. No refrigerator from next door.*

day5_morning_dawn_8.text: *I held my breath and opened the door. The hallway. Only the green glow of emergency lights. No one's here.*

day5_morning_dawn_9.text: *No one is there. And yet, under the emergency light, only the CCTV lens slowly turns toward me.*

day5_morning_dawn_10.text: *I went down the stairs. Muffled my footsteps. The predawn streets. Streetlights glowing orange. No signs of life. No cars. Just the wind.*

day5_morning_dawn_11.text:
*Only my footsteps were left on the dawn street.*

*My phone turns back on. For 0.2 seconds, the name on the lock screen changes.*

*`S-13`*

*Then `{name}` again.*

day5_morning_dawn_12.text:
*Twenty minutes to school. Only my footsteps echo on the predawn road.*

*Every clue meets beneath the old building. I have to check the basement first.*

day5_morning_school_1.text: *The school came into view. In the dark, only the outline of the building showed. The usual windows were all shut black.*

day5_morning_school_2.text: *The front gate is open. The lock lies on the ground, its shackle undone and swinging.*

day5_morning_school_3.text: *The iron gate sways slightly in the wind, half-open. Creak, creak. The sound amplifies in my ears.*

day5_morning_school_4.text: *The entry terminal beside the front gate is on. No one has touched it, but the light turns green.*

day5_morning_school_6.text: *The terminal screen goes dark. My face reflects in the glass. As if only the name tag were left, the letters came into view before my face.*

day5_morning_school_7.text: *The Student Safety app vibrates. No notification. Just three pulses. Short, long, short. Like someone knocking inside my hand.*

day5_morning_school_8.text: *I pass through the front gate and cross the field. Sand grits under my feet. I stop for a moment in front of the main building, but my feet have already turned toward the old wing.*

day5_morning_school_9.text: *The entrance to the old wing. The door is open. Inside is pitch black. I turned on my phone flashlight. The beam swept across the hallway.*

day5_morning_school_10.text: *Letters are scratched into the wall. Graffiti? No. Fingernail marks. Even though I can't read them, my fingertips follow the strokes.*

day5_morning_school_11.text: *The stairs leading down to the basement. Step by step, the concrete is cold. Somewhere, a pipe resonates. Thump, thump, thump. Like a heartbeat.*

day5_morning_rescue_1.text: *The phone light swept across the basement. Pipes, filing cabinets, old medical equipment. — And a bed in the corner.*

day5_morning_rescue_2.text: *Yuna is tied to the bed. Her eyes are open, but they won't focus. Leather straps wrap around her wrists, the skin rubbed raw and red.*

day5_morning_rescue_2_unknown.text: *Someone is tied to the bed. A girl with a face I don't recognize. Her eyes are open, but they won't focus. Leather straps wrap around her wrists, the skin rubbed raw and red.*

day5_morning_rescue_4_unknown.text: *It is an unfamiliar face, but the breath at the end of that voice catches in my ear. There is no time to think. Freeing her comes first.*

day5_morning_rescue_5_unknown.text: ...I'm Choi Yuna. Photography club. The camera... is in my bag.

day5_morning_rescue_4.text: *Focus returns to Yuna's eyes. Faintly. Yuna realizes I saw the records. Gasping, she opens her mouth.*

day5_morning_rescue_5.text: ...You saw the records... down here, right?

day5_morning_rescue_5a.text: *Yuna's finger points to the scattered pile of documents on the floor. A trembling hand. The direction is clear.*

day5_morning_rescue_7.text: *I undid the leather straps binding Yuna. The knots were tight. My nails scraped raw before I finally got them undone. Yuna's hands are cold. — Mine are too.*

day5_morning_rescue_8.text: ...It isn't that I never knew. It started with the 8th time.

day5_morning_rescue_9.text: The eighth sunbae... asked me to take a photo. 'Leave proof of who I was.'

day5_morning_rescue_10.text: ...Back then the name was 'Choi Siwoo.' Quiet, always sitting in the corner of the library.

day5_morning_rescue_11.text: That day, I couldn't let go of the camera strap. Their eyes were red and blurred.

day5_morning_rescue_12.text: ...I didn't understand then. I only remember the hand holding the camera.

day5_morning_rescue_13.text: ...A few months later, the same face arrived with a different name tag. They didn't recognize me.

day5_morning_rescue_15.text: ...From then on, I pressed the shutter. Every time the name tag changes.

day5_morning_rescue_16.text: The 9th file is disconnected on the third night. The name tag was ‘Han Ji-ho’.

day5_morning_rescue_17.text: ...The name changed, but the request was the same. 'Record me.' Their hand always went to the camera.

day5_morning_rescue_18.text: ...Three years, sunbae. The same face came wearing a different name tag, and made the same request again.

day5_morning_rescue_19.text: *Moisture gathered at the corners of Yuna's eyes, but it did not spill over.*

day5_morning_rescue_20.text: ...My hands shook every time. But if I ran away, there'd be no one left to record it.

day5_morning_rescue_21.text: *"Record me." Yuna already knew those words had not come for the first time.*

day5_morning_rescue_22.text: *I helped Yuna to her feet. Her legs gave out and she staggered. I put her arm over my shoulder.*

day5_morning_escape_end.text: *I grabbed Yuna's arm and headed up the stairs. Getting out comes first.*

day5_morning_true_1.text: *I searched through the documents. I found them where Yuna had pointed.*

day5_morning_true_2.text: *#7 - Photo: a long-haired male student. Name: Kim Taeho. ...A ravaged face. Cheeks hollow enough to show bone. The angle of the cheekbones. The corners of the eyes. But the face - is mine.*

day5_morning_true_3.text:
*The remarks section for #7 is long. Red stamps overlap each other.*

*`S-07 / external contact / companion: Lee Seolhwa / result: subject secured`*

*The line beneath it has been crossed out twice in black pen.*

*`S-07 -> S-08`*

day5_morning_true_4.text: ...Lee Seolhwa... the girl you talk to in the hallway... she's in here...

day5_morning_true_5.text: *Yuna can't continue. Her breath keeps breaking short.*

day5_morning_true_6.text: *More documents are scattered across the floor. There's no time to read them. I photographed them with my phone. Even one more page matters.*

day5_morning_true_7.text: Sunbae... over there... that might be Ms. Eunsu's journal...

day5_morning_true_8.text: *Yuna points while leaning against the bed. Another stack of documents. Clean handwriting. Tidy sentences. Sentences that describe people like objects. - Ms. Eunsu's observation log.*

day5_morning_true_9.text: ***'Trial #7 Remarks: Drug resistance reaction. External contact confirmed with facility student Lee Seolhwa (female, 17). Result: subject secured. Lee Seolhwa — unmodifiable. S-07 — re-registered as S-08.'***

day5_morning_true_10.text: *...Lee Seolhwa. There is a small photo pasted beside the name. That face from the back seat of the classroom. Under the photo, an arrow has been drawn in what looks like my handwriting.*

day5_morning_true_11.text: ***Processing time 23:02. S-07 re-registration time 23:11. The two times are attached to the same line.***

day5_morning_true_12.text: *A stamp marks the corner of the document. `Discarded`. The ink has run, seeping into the grain of the desk.*

day5_morning_true_13.text: *My phone camera focuses automatically. A photograph of Lee Seolhwa. The empty space beside it. Only the spot I had always seen is blank white.*

day5_morning_true_14.text: ***'After Trial #8: Subject converses with blank point. Repeats "Lee Seolhwa". Companion response has calming effect. Reevaluate dosage.'***

day5_morning_true_15.text: *It's Ms. Eunsu's handwriting. In the same neat strokes she used on the blackboard in class, it says: `Drug dosage needs review`.*

day5_morning_true_16.text: ***'Trials #9-#12: Same phenomenon. No matching student in camera/entry/seat records. Subject leaves the same seat empty.'***

day5_morning_true_17.text: ***'Addendum: Acute anxiety when blank seat is removed. Leave undisturbed at this stage.'***

day5_morning_true_18.text: *My hand stopped on the paper before I could finish reading the sentence. `Blank seat`. `Left undisturbed`. `Contributes to stability`. The camera focus trembled over those words.*

day5_morning_true_19.text:
*The name label in the dialogue window blinked once.*

*`Seolhwa`*

*`Blank`*

*Then `Seolhwa` again.*

day5_morning_true_20.text: ***The back seat, the end of the hall, the closed door. Every place that belonged to Seolhwa was blank in the records.***

day5_morning_true_21.text: ***In the seat where she had been sitting, the camera had captured nothing from the very beginning.***

day5_morning_true_22.text: *The last page of the observation log. The date was two days ago.*

day5_morning_true_23.text: ***'Trial #13 Day 2: Unauthorized contact with Choi Yuna. Risk of copy leakage. Recommend isolation.'***

day5_morning_true_24.text: ***'Trial #13 Day 3: Choi Yuna isolation complete. Separate copy confirmed. Report on hold.'***

day5_morning_true_25.text: *Two days ago. The date from the day Yuna showed me the photo is stamped in the observation log too.*

day5_morning_true_27.text: ***In the photo, Lee Seolhwa's last recorded date is one year ago. From the next page on, only my face continues, under different names.***

day5_morning_true_28.text: *I looked at Yuna. The red marks on her wrists were level with the corners of the documents.*

day5_morning_true_29.text: ...I need to... get out of here. They're... coming soon.

day5_morning_true_30.text: Sunbae... Ms. Riin will be down soon. She always comes to give the medicine.

day5_morning_true_31.text: *Yuna grabs onto me. Her grip is weak.*

day5_morning_true_32.text: ...Sunbae. It's all in this camera. Three years of... who you were.

day5_morning_true_33.text: If we get out of here... you have to take this with you...

day5_morning_true_34.text: *I took Yuna's hand. It was cold.*

day5_morning_true_35.text: *I photographed every document on the floor that I could. Edina Foundation logo. Nevergrad Final Report. Beneath the cover, a return-on-investment table.*

day5_morning_true_36.text: *Identity Package Change Protocol. Parents, hometown, previous school, friends' names. Each field has an application date and review mark.*

day5_morning_true_37.text: *Board approval document. Commercialization proposal. A note beside the expected return: `After S-13 stabilization data is secured`.*

day5_morning_true_38.text: *Last page. 'Trial #13: Blank-seat response persists. Repeats Lee Seolhwa designation. Residual memory threshold exceeded. Review early processing.'*

day5_morning_true_39.text: *`Review early processing`. The words kept shaking inside the camera focus.*

day5_morning_true_timer_choice.text: *No matter what choice I make — there's no time.*

day5_morning_true_run_1.text: *I shoved the evidence into my bag and grabbed Yuna's arm.*

day5_morning_true_hide_1.text: *I hid in the shadows behind the filing cabinets. I put a finger to my lips, trying to keep Yuna's trembling breaths from being heard. Footsteps passed by on the stairs above.*

day5_morning_true_hide_2.text: *...But I can't stay here much longer. I have to move eventually.*

day5_morning_true_exit_1.text: *As I climbed the stairs — Ms. Eunsu stood there, blocking the hallway towards the old building's exit.*

day5_morning_true_exit_2.text: {name}... Where did you get that camera?

day5_morning_true_ft.text: *The teacher smiles without delaying even a beat. Yuna holds the camera hidden in the palm of her hand.*
choices: Teacher, move aside. I know everything I saw in the basement.
I got lost. I'm sorry, I'll leave right now.
Yuna suddenly feels dizzy. I'm taking her to the nurse's office.

day5_morning_true_ft_confront.text: ...{name}, that's not something to discuss in the hallway. Put the camera down and come with me.

day5_morning_true_ft_lost.text: It's all right. You're not hurt? - I'll walk you back. Take your time.

day5_morning_true_ft_yuna.text: ...All right. The nurse's office is on the second floor of the main building. Let's go together. I'll help you support her.

day5_morning_true_ft_stall.text: Hold on. Slow down. — Hear the teacher out before you go, hm?

day5_morning_true_post_ft_1.text: *Ms. Eunsu placed a hand on my shoulder. Her hand is warm. Her fingertips slowly tightened inward.*

day5_morning_true_post_ft_2.text: *The teacher didn't immediately grab me. Instead, they cast their gaze upwards. At that moment, the sound of a metal door slamming shut echoed from somewhere.*

day5_morning_true_post_ft_3.text: *...It's a trap. That face, watching to see how far I'd go, what I'd grab, where I'd run. I grabbed Yuna's wrist and brushed past the teacher.*

day5_morning_blockade_1.text: *I came up the stairs. End of the hallway — the door is shut. The door that was open until yesterday. A steel locking bar is in place. That wasn't there yesterday.*

day5_morning_blockade_2.text: *I ran to the opposite end. The other hallway door — also shut. Locked.*

day5_morning_blockade_4.text: *My eyes met Yuna's. Her face is white. My fingertips had gone cold too.*

day5_morning_blockade_5.text: *Ksshht— Static burst from the speakers. Then underneath it, a sound. A music box. A slow, off-key music box melody, like a warped graduation song.*

day5_morning_broadcast_2.text: *Ms. Eunsu's voice rings through the speakers. Warm as always. Too even. Saliva gathers in my mouth. I swallow. It tastes metallic.*

day5_morning_broadcast_3.text: Today is a special day. We have a **graduation ceremony**.

day5_morning_broadcast_4.text: *Graduation ceremony. The words echoed through the hallway. Bouncing off walls, hitting the ceiling, coming back again.*

day5_morning_broadcast_5.text: {name}. Would you come to the classroom?

day5_morning_broadcast_7.text: *The music box played one more measure — then cut off. The broadcast ended. Silence.*

day5_morning_broadcast_9.text: *Yuna's voice trembles. The fingers gripping my sleeve tighten.*

day5_morning_broadcast_10.text: We're not going. There's an escape route on the 3rd floor of the old wing that Seolhwa found.

day5_morning_broadcast_11.text: ...The 3rd floor is just two flights of stairs from here—

day5_morning_broadcast_12.text: *Thud. The sound of a door closing above. A heavy steel door closing.*

day5_morning_broadcast_13.text: *Yuna stopped mid-sentence. We both looked up. Thud. Another one. The 3rd floor is sealed too.*

day5_morning_broadcast_15.text: *Yuna grabbed my sleeve. Her fingers gripping tight.*

day5_morning_broadcast_17.text: *There might not be one. Yuna's hand tightened harder around my sleeve.*

day5_morning_broadcast_18.text: *Only the classroom door is open. Every other door is locked. There's only one way to go.*

day5_morning_grad_1.text: ...I'll wait outside. If I go in — they'll catch me too.

day5_morning_grad_3.text: Don't be sorry. I'm okay. — When you come out, we run together.

day5_morning_grad_4.text: *Yuna hid in the corner of the hallway. I pressed the record button on my phone.*

day5_morning_grad_6.text: ***No one is here. 30 empty desks. Every chair faces the blackboard. Rows and spacing aligned as if measured with a ruler.***

day5_morning_grad_7.text: *On each desk, a name tag. Numbers 1 through 12. Cycle numbers and the names assigned then. — Seat 13 is empty. My seat.*

day5_morning_grad_8.text: ***Written on the blackboard: 'Congratulations on Your Graduation — 13th'***

day5_morning_grad_9.text: *The chalk writing is clean. White powder still lies beneath the blackboard. It's Ms. Eunsu's neat handwriting, the same strokes she used in class.*

day5_morning_grad_10.text: *Papers are stacked on the lectern. 13 of them. Each clipped together, with a photo attached. — They're all me. Same face. Different names.*

day5_morning_grad_12.text: *Ms. Eunsu lifts the paper from the lectern. The edge of the page doesn't tremble.*

day5_morning_grad_13.text: It's your diploma. In your name.

day5_morning_grad_14.text: *13 names on paper. From ‘Kim Do-jin’ to ‘{name}’. The title is not ‘Diploma’ but ‘Confirmation of Processing Completion’. The seal has been stamped twelve times, and only the last space is dry.*

day5_morning_grad_15.text: *Ms. Eunsu turns over the first page. Kim Dojin. A sentence is written in red pen beside the photo.*

day5_morning_grad_16.text: ***'Day 3 22:14. Attempted to leave through the front gate. Recovered.'***

day5_morning_grad_17.text: *The second page. Lee Junseo. There is a small stain on the corner of the paper. I can't tell whether it's coffee or water.*

day5_morning_grad_18.text: *The fifth page. Kang Minhyuk. The attached memo reads, 'Increased time spent in faculty office. Dependency response favorable.'*

day5_morning_grad_19.text: *The sixth page. Jeong Hayul. A black clip over the photo. Beside it, a photo of a drug vial is attached.*

day5_morning_grad_20.text: *On the seventh page, Ms. Eunsu's hand stops. Kim Taeho. Another photo is half tucked behind his. A white-haired schoolgirl. Her face has been deliberately cropped out.*

day5_morning_grad_21a.text: *The lectern drawer is half open. I can see a letter inside. 'Thanks to you, I had a wonderful school life.' The name is Song Yejun. The date is the night of Day 5 in the 10th cycle.*

day5_morning_grad_23.text: *Picks up chopsticks with the left hand. Skips the third stair. Rests the right cheek in the hand when looking out the window. Shakes chocolate milk twice.*

day5_morning_grad_24.text: *My habits are organized like a classroom observation chart.*

day5_morning_grad_25.text: ...Even when memories are erased, something remains.

day5_morning_grad_27.text: *The silence stretches. What I saw was not a confession, but an old observation sheet.*

day5_morning_grad_29.text: *She starts to say my name, then looks back at the checklist.*

day5_morning_grad_29a.text: *That expression is the strangest one yet. Not affection. The face of someone checking something she memorized.*

day5_morning_grad_30.text: ...If you have questions, ask them now.

day5_morning_grad_reply_1b.text: Right. That's what the first page says. I hid behind it for a while too.

day5_morning_grad_reply_2.text: ...The first approval only had the board seal. My name wasn't there.

day5_morning_grad_reply_2b.text: *Ms. Eunsu places a finger on the third page. It is stamped 'Extension Approval Request.' Applicant: Park Eunsu.*

day5_morning_grad_reply_2c.text: ...From here on, it has my signature.

day5_morning_grad_reply_3.text: *The corners of Teacher Eunsu’s mouth rose. The muscles under the eyes were stiff.*

day5_morning_proposal_1.text: *Silence settled. Just the two of us left in the classroom.*

day5_morning_proposal_2.text: *Ms. Eunsu stepped away from the lectern. One step, two steps. Walking toward me. Stopped. — Two meters away.*

day5_morning_proposal_3.text: *Teacher's lips moved. No sound came out. Again.*

day5_morning_proposal_5.text: *The words fell low among the empty desks. The teacher knelt in front of the teacher’s table.*

day5_morning_proposal_6.text: I know it's not something that can be erased with an apology.

day5_morning_proposal_7.text: *She does not look at the approval forms bearing her own name. As if she has already memorized them.*

day5_morning_proposal_8.text: *The teacher raised his head. The corners of his eyes were red.*

day5_morning_proposal_9.text: Still... when you're here, the numbers stabilize. No, I do.

day5_morning_proposal_10.text: *The teacher got to their feet. Without wiping the wetness from their eyes.*

day5_morning_proposal_13.text: One. Stay here. I'll leave your place as it is. I won't erase your memories.

day5_morning_proposal_14.text: Two. Erase it. The pain, the body trying to run, all of it quiets down. We can start over next Monday.

day5_morning_end_cage.text: *...My feet won't move. I sat down in the chair. Ms. Eunsu smiles.*

day5_morning_end_forget.text: *...I closed my eyes. Ms. Eunsu's hand touches my forehead. It's cold.*

day5_morning_end_run.text: *My body moved first. My legs found the angle toward the stairs before I did. — I ran.*
